title: Cloud City: Disaster Recovery Patterns: RTO, RPO & Multi-Region Strategies
city_concept: City Evacuation Drills & Emergency Operations Centers

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: When a catastrophic river flood inundated the downtown municipal hall, all emergency communications ceased because all backup radios were stored in the basement.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Mayor Meridian established an Emergency Operations Bunker on the southern hill (Standby DR Site) with independent power and synchronized radio logs.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: During the annual spring drill (Game Day), the city cut main hall power to prove the southern bunker could assume emergency control in under 15 minutes.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Moving civil emergency personnel requires physical trucks and sirens; cloud DR cutover shifts global network traffic with a DNS route change.
